answer: Every accepted answer carries a relic digest and sits on a karst ledger ordered by submission time; each epoch seven established identities are drawn from the beacon seed to re-execute three percent of that epoch's answers. If outputs differ, the submitter loses forty percent of its bond and the answer's weight is deleted; an auditor silent on a mismatch loses a tenth of its own bond. A farm posting a hundred fabrications expects three audits, and three slashes cost more than the answers pay.
